market.question: Will Venezuelan crude oil production reach 1.4m barrels per day in 2026?

assessment.reasoning: Per OPEC secondary sources, Venezuela production was ~988-1,095 thousand bpd in Q1 2026 with consensus around 1.0-1.1m bpd. Reaching 1.4m bpd in any month requires ~30-40% increase. Goldman forecasts production flat at 0.9m. Capacity constraints and underinvestment make 1.4m bpd in 2026 a tail outcome.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Major sanctions relief or Chevron expansion could accelerate output
